facts.business: One 97 Communications Limited (Paytm) operates a payment-led business model, providing omni-channel payment services (QR, Soundbox, POS, online gateway) to merchants and consumers, and distributing financial services such as merchant loans, personal loans, equity broking, and insurance through lending partners.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding a Show Cause Notice (SCN) received by the Company and its two subsidiaries from the Directorate of Enforcement alleging contraventions of FEMA provisions. The opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Show Cause Notice from Directorate of Enforcement alleging FEMA contraventions
Impairment risk on investments in subsidiaries and associates
Dependence on lending partners for financial services distribution
Regulatory and compliance risks in fintech sector
facts.related_party_note: Inter-corporate loans of INR 10 crore (2026) and INR 208 crore (2025) classified as Level 3 fair value investments; investments in optionally convertible debentures of INR 12 crore (2026) and INR 72 crore (2025); investments in compulsorily convertible preference shares of INR 10 crore (2026) and INR 12 crore (2025).
